description: This file defines a Java interface 'DevOpsCommand' which specifies the structure and behavior of DevOps-related commands within an Eclipse Ditto-based project. It includes method signatures, constants, and nested classes for JSON field definitions relevant to DevOps commands.

classes.name: DevOpsCommand
classes.description: A generic interface for all DevOps commands in the Eclipse Ditto platform, extending command capabilities and including constants for command types and resource types.

classes.name: DevOpsCommand.JsonFields
classes.description: A static inner class defining JSON field definitions for 'serviceName' and 'instance' fields used in DevOps commands.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the specific type of the DevOps command.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Sets Ditto headers on the command, part of the Command interface.

methods.name: getTypePrefix
methods.description: Returns the type prefix constant for DevOps commands.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns an empty JsonPointer indicating the resource path for DevOps commands.

methods.name: getServiceName
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the service name targeted by this command.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the instance index of the targeted service.
